name: Station portable

supportPointQA.method: Read-only alpha segmentation of lowest8percent silhouette, equal weighting of separated boot intervals; lowest sole determines floor; retain far-foot perspective height difference.

prompt: Create exactly ONE finished 2D fighting-game character sprite on a completely transparent RGBA background. One full body only, isolated, entire head/hair, hands, all equipment and both boot soles fully inside the canvas with modest clear margins. Tall portrait canvas; character occupies about 87% of height. Right-facing three-quarter side view looking at the opponent to the right, grounded neutral combat-ready stance, no action sequence, no sprite sheet, no additional views, no text, no labels, no scenery, no glow cloud, no ground shadow, no rotation. Crisp detailed hand-painted/cel-shaded 2D game art with clean readable contours, natural anatomy and coherent mechanical detail. Use the attached identity reference ONLY for the appropriate same-period character, especially face, hairstyle, age, stature and defining equipment. The attachment contains multiple poses; choose its top-left standing figure as identity reference and render just one newly drawn figure. This is a NEW ORIGINAL CQC alternative costume, not an official Konami outfit and not a recovery of a lost image. MEI LING, Metal Gear Solid 1 incarnation only, young adult Chinese woman with exact dark tied ponytail, side fringe, warm fair/medium skin tone and slender upright proportions of attached top-left figure. Costume OC-004 Station portable: practical midnight-blue communications vest with several compact radio/data modules, over a dark blue long-sleeve crew-neck field shirt; tailored navy utility trousers, short durable field boots, subtle violet accent seams remembering her original office outfit. Small flat deployable communication terminal folded at left hip, a compact antenna radio on back and short neatly secured cables; carry a small closed field tablet in one hand, other relaxed. Hair and face remain uncovered and recognisable; no generic military helmet, no gasmask, no cyborg body. This is a light transmission-specialist expedition outfit, clearly different from the old purple generic survivor. Full practical modest clothing.
limits: New authored interpretation of the pre-established ORIGINAL CQC costume brief; not an official alternative costume.
